brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching
requirements.evidence: Build has 3 full bases at 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 / 0,1,0 forming a triangular cluster. Spike spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 sits at junction {0,0/0,1/1,0} (posMm 47.8,82.9). Drawer frame notch:0#1,1#notch2 at empty cell 1,1 k=2 fills the V between 1,0,0 and 0,1,0 with its tip pointing SW to the same junction. MeshClash clear, so they coexist touching at that corner - the SW corner of cell 1,1 which is also the NE corner of cells 1,0,0 and 0,1,0 and 0,0,0.

finish.summary: Three-base triangle with spike at the shared junction and drawer-frame notch in the adjacent empty cell pointing into the same junction; caps and joint bolts applied, mesh clear.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
